For you

Happy 20th birthday to the most beautiful person I know, inside and out. Twenty years of you becoming exactly who you are today, the girl who makes my ordinary days feel like something worth smiling about. I don't think you fully realize how much lighter everything feels just because you exist in my world. I could write a hundred pages about all the little things I love about you, your laugh that I'd choose over any song, the way you get so excited over the smallest things, how you somehow make even my bad days okay just by being you. But today isn't about all of that. Today is just about celebrating you. So happy birthday, my love. Here's to you, to us, and to every birthday I get to spend loving you a little more than the year before. You deserve every good thing this year brings, and I'll be right here making sure it does. I love you more than words on this page could ever hold. Forever yours 🤍
Purely for celebration purposes
